attributes.check1: Dexterity or Acrobatics or Disable or Intelligence 9
attributes.name: Trapped Sarcophagus
attributes.powers:
When you examine this card, succeed at a Perception 9 check or you are dealt 1d4 Electricity damage.

If undefeated, each character at this location recharges 1d4 cards then is dealt 1d6 Electricity damage.

"Built so that the honored dead would have company."—Hepsikah, architect of Akhentepi's tomb
